label: Milrinone
summary: Phosphodiesterase-3 inhibitor that raises contractility and dilates blood vessels, an inodilator. It is cleared by the kidneys and has a longer half-life than dobutamine.
nursingPriorities: Expect hypotension, especially with a loading dose; watch MAP closely.
It accumulates in kidney dysfunction, so trend creatinine and urine output and confirm renal dosing.
